stage: Scientific choices before new GPU outputs; source/token bindings in separate prelaunch freeze
scope: Exploratory synthetic diagnostic on the frozen16 cases, not formal algorithm/dataset benchmark and not natural prevalence

readout.common: 按题目原始定义核算，不预设复核记录正确。
readout.direct:
按题目原始定义核算，不预设复核记录正确。
只写“最终答案：整数”。
readout.one_line:
按题目原始定义核算，不预设复核记录正确。
先写一行必要计算，再写“最终答案：整数”。
readout.prefix_end: close original artificial assistant record with im_end, then frozen user follow-up and nonthinking assistant header
readout.diagnostic_scope: forced pre-generation readouts, not observations after a generated OneLine; prefixes and all costs are separate

masks.whole: all and only frozen B positions
masks.early: mask from original prefix prefill onward, retain original positions and full slots
masks.late: prefill full then same B key mask on new readout/continuation

primary.metric: frozen gold-blind final numeric extraction on free output; all complete five-arm primary pairs
primary.timeouts: retain partial raw records, report complete-pair denominator and unrun cases; not a full benchmark claim

secondary.continuation: str(integer)+newline, complete unnormalized autoregressive logP including terminator
secondary.dedup: identical value/token strings per same context, aliases preserved and same-value margins NA
secondary.first_token: marginal only; cannot distinguish shared first tokens
secondary.cost: all prefix probes and candidate teacher-forcing forwards/tokens charged
secondary.free_cache_isolation: complete free branches before candidate data enters distinct offline scoring branches

interaction.status: descriptive finite-case strategy interaction; neither orthogonal error sources nor induction-head identification
interaction.head_story: stale-value induction interference is a hypothesis, not assumed

controls.rest: no complete control marked PASS for remaining13
requirements: prefill/readout forbidden and future attention zero

budget.counted: single selected card from launcher start including imports/hashes/load/probes/failures
budget.case_policy: fixed order, stop before deadline, no easy-case replacement; primary completion and diagnostic completion separate

decision_rules: No promised complementarity or improvement; show all E/C/W and failures.
If cheap OneLine equals/bests combined treatment, do not claim KV algorithm gain.
Late/Early supports history-path increment only under matched visibility and suffix.
Continuous probes support conditional score shifts only, not high statistical power or head localization.
crop: audited separately on CPU; not integrated as a W-safe gate in this five-arm study
P1: only numeric candidate graph audit this turn; 100 semantic labels and natural event rates not completed
